import sys

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().strip().split()
    if not data:
        return
    n = int(data[0])
    a = list(map(int, data[1:1+n]))
    t = int(data[1+n])
    a.sort()
    num = 0
    for i in range(n):
        count = 0
        last = a[i] + t
        for j in range(i, n):
            if a[j] >= a[i] and a[j] <= last:
                count += 1
        if count > num:
            num = count
    sys.stdout.write(str(num))

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
